CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub Detail_Format(Cancel As Integer, FormatCount As Integer)
If Len(Nume) > 29 Then
    Nume.FontName = "Arial Narrow"
Else
    Nume.FontName = "Consolas"
End If
If Len(Grupa) > 24 Then
    Grupa.FontName = "Arial Narrow"
Else
    Grupa.FontName = "Consolas"
End If

End Sub

Private Sub Report_Load()
DoCmd.Maximize
End Sub

Private Sub Report_NoData(Cancel As Integer)
MsgBox "Nu exista date in raportul selectat!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
Cancel = True
End Sub
